title: Cozy Room Portfolio
summary: This site: my real room rebuilt in 3D, where the monitor is the portfolio.
problem: Portfolios all look the same; I wanted one that proves 3D and front-end skills by being one.
solution: React Three Fiber scene modelled on my desk setup, day/night lighting with soft shadows, a switchable LED arc, an HTML mini-OS inside the monitor and zod-validated JSON content.
result: Adding a project = adding a JSON file and pushing; GitHub Actions rebuilds and deploys.
